title: Inbound event silo and type-safe adaptor
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: The consoles usage pipeline is experiencing intermittent rejections and silent drops when downstream schema relaxations and producer variant payloads arrive. Current validators are brittle: they either accept too much (causing bad analytics and noise) or reject too aggressively (dropping events without sufficient observability).

Goal: Implement an inbound event silo that centralizes pre-ingest adaption and a type-safe adaptor layer that performs deterministic, reversible coercions and enrichment. The silo should provide: staged validation (soft/strict), per-tenant schema fingerprints, sampling for rejected payloads to S3 for investigation, and hooks for canary policy rollouts. The adaptor should provide well-documented transformation rules, safe default coercions, and metrics to tie back to Console dashboards.

Constraints: Must not increase p99 ingestion latency by more than 25ms for the common path; storage for sampled payloads limited to 200GB/month initially; changes must be reversible and feature-flagged for canary rollout. Integration with KMS (for PII redaction) is out of scope for this ticket and handled in a follow-up.
acceptance_criteria: Inbound silo accepts events from the existing gateway with no schema change to producers and routes through the new adaptor path when feature flag is enabled
Soft validator mode emits structured validation warnings and increments a new metric bucket but does not drop events
Strict validator mode rejects events and writes a sampled copy (1%) of rejected payloads to the investigation S3 bucket with tenant and fingerprint metadata
Adaptor exposes a clear transform spec in the repo (MD) and implements at least three reversible coercions (string->enum, trim/normalize timestamp, default missing array to empty array)
End-to-end tests validate that canonical payloads pass both soft and strict modes, and that sampled rejected events are queryable from the investigation bucket
Performance: average added latency for accepted events < 25ms at 99th percentile under representative load (from perf harness)
tasks: Design the inbound silo API and feature flagging contract with Console team
Implement type-safe adaptor library (Go) with pluggable coercion registry
Add soft/strict validation modes and metrics (counters + histograms)
Integrate sampled rejected payloads writer and S3 lifecycle policy
Create repo MD transform spec and migration notes for downstream analytics consumers
Add unit/integration tests and a perf harness scenario; run baseline and canary runs
Prepare runbook and rollback steps for enabling adaptor feature flag
